note: interrupted = a label that started but has no result in the journal; the orchestrator stopped every run at the usage limit. prevMerged = the transcripts already passed in args.prev for that key, then every transcript of that label in this run, oldest first. For simlab-facts-gm.js, args.prev is keyed by item id (label without its facts:/check: prefix).

items.label: parts:inputs
items.title: RGB LED, push button, potentiometer, LDR, TMP36, FSR 402 and piezo buzzer

items.label: parts:drivers
items.title: TIP120, 2N2222, 1N4007, DC motor, fan, SG90 servo and 28BYJ-48 stepper

items.label: item:nano
items.title: Arduino Nano
items.notes: ATmega328P, breadboard-friendly; most robotics benches put it on the mat, so its pins and power must be exact.

items.label: item:esp32-devkitc
items.title: ESP32-DevKitC
items.notes: ESP32-WROOM-32E DevKitC V4: strapping pins, input-only GPIO34-39, ADC2 unavailable while Wi-Fi runs, 3.3 V logic; languages arduino-cpp and micropython (ids.ts); the wireless lesson uses Wi-Fi as far as the interpreter models it.

items.label: item:pico
items.title: Raspberry Pi Pico
items.notes: Variant switch Pico / Pico 2 / Pico W / Pico 2 W (seed S12): RP2040 vs RP2350, the LED on GP25 vs the CYW43 'LED' pin on W boards, BOOTSEL; MicroPython first, arduino-cpp second.

items.label: item:esp32-s3-devkitc-1
items.title: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1
items.notes: v1.1 has the RGB LED on GPIO38, v1.0 on GPIO48: support both as variants (seed S13); the two USB ports (UART bridge and native USB); strapping pins.

items.label: item:uno-r4
items.title: Arduino Uno R4
items.notes: Variant switch Minima / WiFi (seed S12): Renesas RA4M1 (32-bit int), and on the WiFi the ESP32-S3 module and the 12 x 8 LED matrix; the differences are in the fact sheet.

items.label: item:nodemcu
items.title: NodeMCU (ESP8266)
items.notes: NodeMCU v3 / ESP-12E: the D-pin to GPIO map, the on-board LED on GPIO2 (D4) active low, boot pins GPIO0/2/15, the A0 divider.

items.label: parts:modules
items.title: ULN2003 driver board, SSD1306 OLED, traffic-light module and capacitive soil-moisture sensor

items.label: item:microbit-v2
items.title: BBC micro:bit V2
items.notes: nRF52833, the 5 x 5 LED matrix, buttons A/B, touch logo, speaker and microphone, LSM303AGR, the edge connector with its big rings; MicroPython (microbit module).

items.label: item:nucleo-f401re
items.title: STM32 Nucleo-F401RE
items.notes: STM32F401RE with ST-LINK/V2-1, Arduino Uno V3 headers plus ST morpho, LD2 on PA5 (D13), B1 on PC13, its jumpers and solder bridges, 5 V-tolerant FT pins vs the analog pins.

items.label: item:pi4-pi5
items.title: Raspberry Pi 4 / Pi 5
items.notes: Variant switch Pi 4 Model B / Pi 5 (seed S12): the 40-pin header with 3.3 V GPIO (not 5 V tolerant), power (Pi 4: 5 V 3 A USB-C; Pi 5: 5 V 5 A PD), the Pi 5's RP1, Python gpiozero lessons, the power and activity LED states.

items.label: parts:mat
items.title: TT gear motor, NEMA 17 stepper, 2S LiPo, 4 x AA holder and the multimeter

items.label: item:basys3
items.title: Digilent Basys 3
items.notes: XC7A35T-1CPG236C: 16 switches, 16 LEDs, 5 buttons, the 4-digit 7-segment display, Pmods, VGA, USB-UART; pins carry their XDC names (fpgaPin).

items.label: item:de10-lite
items.title: Terasic DE10-Lite
items.notes: 10M50DAF484C7G MAX 10: 10 switches, 10 LEDs, 2 KEY buttons, six 7-segment displays, the accelerometer, VGA, the Arduino header; pins carry their QSF names (fpgaPin).

items.title: LED + resistor and Ohm's law
items.notes: No controller: a supply, an LED, a resistor and the multimeter (parts:mat writes figures/parts/multimeter.js); measure and break it.

items.label: item:transistor-switch
items.title: Transistor motor switch
items.notes: Nano drives a TIP120 with the 1N4007 flyback diode, a TT motor and the 4 x AA holder (all from the parts agents).

items.label: item:tb6612fng
items.title: TB6612FNG dual motor driver
items.notes: Nano + TB6612FNG + two TT motors on a 2S LiPo; STBY, PWM and direction logic.

items.label: item:l298n
items.title: L298N motor driver
items.notes: Nano + L298N + TT motors on a 2S LiPo; the 5 V regulator jumper, the voltage drop and the heat.

items.label: item:uno-r3-build
items.title: Build an Arduino Uno R3
items.notes: The bare-PCB build of the Uno R3 (SMD then THT) on the bench, ending with Blink; the board figure belongs to engine:bench, so reference figures/boards/uno-r3.js and request any board-side additions in your requests file.

items.label: item:esp32-s3-build
items.title: Build an ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1
items.notes: The DevKitC-1 build with its RGB LED and Wi-Fi bring-up; the board figure belongs to item:esp32-s3-devkitc-1, so request board-side additions in your requests file.

items.label: item:pi5-ros2
items.title: Raspberry Pi 5 with ROS 2
items.notes: Pi 5 (variant pi5) power budget and a ROS 2 rclpy node through the interpreter's shim; the board figure belongs to item:pi4-pi5.

items.label: item:a4988
items.title: A4988 stepper driver
items.notes: Nano + A4988 + NEMA 17 on a 2S LiPo; microstepping pins, setting Vref with the multimeter, the 100 uF capacitor.

items.label: item:pca9685
items.title: PCA9685 servo driver
items.notes: Nano + PCA9685 over I2C + SG90 servos; the V+ servo rail vs VCC, addresses, pulse widths.

items.label: item:mpu6050
items.title: MPU-6050 IMU
items.notes: Nano + MPU-6050 over I2C; raw readings, offsets, a complementary filter.

items.label: item:hc-sr04
items.title: HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor
items.notes: Nano + HC-SR04; trigger/echo timing, the speed of sound, the 5 V echo into 3.3 V boards caution. The Uno R3 lessons 7 and 16 also place this module in their circuits.

items.label: item:qtr-8rc
items.title: QTR-8RC line sensor array
items.notes: Nano + QTR-8RC; RC timing reads, calibration, the line-follower practice task.

items.label: item:lm2596
items.title: LM2596 buck converter
items.notes: No controller: a 2S LiPo through the LM2596 to a TT motor load; setting the output with the trimmer, efficiency, brown-out under load.
